scope: all repository work units, workflows, writers, and client adapters
invariants: Every unfinished work unit has stable work_unit_id, writer_id, exact_head_sha and durable successor receipt
A context boundary, tool return, failed CI, API rate limit or workflow transition is not completion
A successor must read back its predecessor and verify writer, work unit, exact head and integrity before continuing
Unresolved predecessors cannot be overwritten or silently dropped
External authorization and workflow admission remain fail-closed; no retry may bypass these gates
Merge, deployment, and effect acknowledgement require independent verified evidence
Every failed CI must produce TEMDD diagnosis and a typed next action
A retry must be bounded, idempotent, rate-limit-aware and must not create unbounded workflow cascades
